notes.title: Prostitute Simulator 2. Launches on July 25!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488480/Prostitute_Simulator_2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42626270/9c41bd0e81ccee41c3d2c857fee923be04ddd2de.png[/img][/url]

This new installment changes and adds hundreds of things to bring you a much better game than the previous one.

You will be able to choose between your favorite style: Anime or realistic and enjoy animated scenes with that style.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42626270/c28786ed39c346dcf4a5bf6e1404b5b1c097c05e.png[/img]

⚫︎ Improve your sexual performance with different mini-games to get extra money while experiencing chaos in three different cities around the world thanks to a random event system.

⚫︎ An exciting story that will take you around the world for 30 days with the prostitute of your choice.

⚫︎ Travel to three cities around the world: Japan, Middle East and Brazil.

⚫︎ Random events cause chaos in the cities so that every day is different.

notes.title: Halloween event is over.
notes.content: Halloween event is over. Now everyone is back to normal. The policemen are no longer zombies and the special skin costs in-game yen.

notes.title: The halloween event has just started!

The halloween event has just started! You can not lose this!
